title: SWF: SetBackgroundColor and FrameLabel tags
description: Unit tests verifying SetBackgroundColor (tag 9) and FrameLabel (tag 43) are emitted in SWF output. Create a doc with backgroundColor='#FF0000', export to SWF, parse tag stream for tag type 9 (SetBackgroundColor) and verify body is 0xFF 0x00 0x00. Create a doc with a frame label, export, verify FrameLabel tag (type 43) contains the label string. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/bgcolorlabel.test.ts.
